subject: mathematics
title: Chance Check
objective: Describe real-life outcomes as certain, likely, unlikely, or impossible.
introduction: Milo is testing chance with a coin, clouds, and a jar of shells. Can you tell what is certain, likely, unlikely, or impossible?

vocabulary.term: a fair coin can land heads
vocabulary.definition: A coin has two sides, so it can land on heads or tails.

vocabulary.term: a fish breathing on land is impossible
vocabulary.definition: Fish breathe with gills, so breathing on land cannot happen.

vocabulary.term: rain may be likely with dark clouds
vocabulary.definition: When the sky is full of dark clouds, rain is likely to come.

items.prompt: Milo flips a fair coin once. Which sentence describes a possible outcome?

options.text: A stone floats in the air — certain
A fish can breathe on land — possible
A fair coin can land heads — a chance
The sun will rise tomorrow — impossible

items.explanation: A fair coin can land on heads or tails, so heads is one possible outcome. The other sentences are false: fish cannot breathe on land, the sun always rises, and stones do not float in air.

items.prompt: A fish is asked to breathe on land. Which chance statement is correct?

options.text: A fish can breathe on land — possible
The sun will rise tomorrow — impossible
A fair die has seven faces — certain
A fish breathing on land is impossible

items.explanation: Fish breathe with gills, so breathing on land is impossible for them. The other sentences say a die has seven faces or that impossible things happen every day.

items.prompt: Dark clouds cover the sky before Milo’s walk. Which chance sentence is true?

options.text: A fish can breathe on land — possible
Rain may be likely when the sky is full of dark clouds
A fair die has seven faces — certain
A coin tossed once always lands on heads — certain

items.explanation: Dark clouds usually bring rain, so rain is likely. The other sentences are false — a die has six faces, fish cannot breathe on land, and a coin can land on tails.

items.prompt: Milo rolls a fair die. Which statement tells the chance correctly?

options.text: A stone floats in the air — likely
The sun will rise tomorrow — impossible
A fish can breathe on land — possible
A fair die has six possible faces

items.explanation: A fair die has exactly six faces: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6. The other sentences say false things like a fish breathing on land or a stone floating in air.

items.prompt: Milo flips a fair coin. Which sentence shows the right chance?

options.text: A fish can breathe on land — likely
A fair coin can land on heads or tails
A fair die has seven faces — possible
A stone floats in the air — certain

items.explanation: A coin has two sides, so it can land on heads or tails. The other sentences say impossible or false things like stones floating in air or a die with seven faces.
